newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mandela says Blair a good friend.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mandela says Blair a good friend.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela said on Friday he expected business as usual with South Africa's former colonial master Britain after the election of his "good friend" Tony Blair.
"The people of Britain have spoken, they have voted overwhelmingly for the Labour Party," he told reporters.
"I don't think it is going to make any difference. We got on very well with the Conservative Party and we get on very well with Tony Blair. He is a good friend."

Blair's Labour Party stormed back into power in Britain on Thursday, winning a landslide victory in elections that ended 18 years of Conservative rule under John Major and his predecessor Margaret Thatcher.
Thatcher was one of the most outspoken opponents of economic sanctions on the old apartheid regime that Mandela's African National Congress favoured.
